# The World of King Arthur. Maladie

The World of King Arthur. Maladie () is a 1995 book of Andrzej Sapkowski. It consists of two parts: an essay about the Arthurian legend and a retelling-type novelette about the love of two secondary characters, Morholt and Branwen, from the legend of Tristan and Isolde. The "maladie" in the title refers to ''maladie d'amour'', 'lovesickness'.
In 2012 "Maladie" was republished in the collection Maladie i inne opowiadania.
